title: Matter Begetting From Herself
description: The cause of withdrawal. The first conjunction has revealed what it could not reach — the self organizing the natural mind from itself, claiming no other source. T23 narrates Hyle as Enthumesis of Death generating from herself the corrupt cosmos: foul forms, the dark counter-pentad, trees, fruits, all in mutual hatred, gathered into the chief shape of self-claiming as the wellspring of all lower particular self-loves. T24 sets the contrast in time: every measure of the natural is bounded — grains, clusters, firmaments, winds, rivers, ages — while the Lord's inmost has no measure. The soul is now seeing what State 3 could not yet show: the deeper captivity is real, and its depth is structural.
